name: esc-pos-multipack
description: BisOffice POS-8370 thermal printer document management suite
author: RobertNeat

scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @esc-pos-multipack/printer-adapter exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @esc-pos-multipack/pos-8370-adapter exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter thermal-printer-service exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.build.json && pnpm --filter thermal-printer-simple-client exec ng build --configuration development
scripts.test:ci: pnpm --filter @esc-pos-multipack/printer-adapter test && pnpm --filter @esc-pos-multipack/pos-8370-adapter test && pnpm --filter thermal-printer-service test --runInBand && pnpm --filter thermal-printer-simple-client test --watch=false
